## Change

Describe the hardware, firmware, model or documentation change.

## Authoritative source

Identify the source-of-truth file changed and any generated consumers.

## Verification

- [ ] `tests/run_all.ps1` passes, or unavailable checks are explained.
- [ ] Interactive BOM synchronization passes.
- [ ] PCB routing hashes are unchanged, or the manual routing change is explicit.
- [ ] Physical measurements are not presented as verified unless evidence is attached.
- [ ] JLC preview was inspected for any manufacturing change.
